questions.question: Solve for x in the quadratic equation: x² - 5x + 6 = 0.
What is the sum of interior angles of a regular hexagon (6 sides)?
If sin(θ) = 3/5 in a right-angled triangle, what is the value of cos(θ)?
questions.explanation: Using Pythagorean triplet 3-4-5, adjacent side is 4, so cos(θ) = 4/5.

questions.question: Find the standard derivative d/dx (3x⁴ - 2x + 7).
questions.explanation: Applying power rule: d/dx(3x⁴) = 12x³ and d/dx(-2x) = -2.
